messages:
ashley: Quick sync — post-launch backlog triage. We need to split this week's cycle into critical bug fixes vs enhancement experiments. Customer A flagged an embedding mismatch + rate-limit spikes. Need a decision by EOD.
kevin: +1. Can we get SLO/regression numbers? Prod metrics show p99 latency up ~30% the last 48h.
maya: Captured A's report in support thread, linking logs and a repro. Severity looks high for one customer flow.
ashley: Proposal: 1) Hotfixes: customer-facing regressions (SEV >= P1) -> aim for a 48h patch. 2) Quick wins: UX/ops fixes <= 2 dev days. 3) Enhancements: defer to next wave unless low-effort. Agree?
jo: Agree. I'll take the embedding mismatch ticket. Estimate ~1.5 days to reproduce + fix.
tiago: I'll pair with Jo — suspect quantization variant mismatch or cache warmup issue.
kevin: Ops notes point to batching window configs causing token bursts. Quick mitigation: reduce batch window from 25ms -> 15ms in canary to reduce p99.
ashley: @kevin please do the canary but limit to 3% traffic for 30m and include a rollback plan.
kevin: Will schedule at 17:00. deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled at 1725001800 -> 3% routes.
deploy-bot: Canary started. Monitoring: latency_p50=120ms, latency_p95=420ms, latency_p99=980ms (baseline pre-canary).
sam: One small enhancement request — queue 'prompt-templates' work but deprioritize if hotfixes eat >50% sprint capacity.
ashley: Agreed. Operational rule for this cycle: cap enhancements at 30% of sprint unless no P1s show up.
maya: I'll update backlog labels and move tickets: postlaunch:bug, postlaunch:quickwin, postlaunch:enhancement. PR template update: require customer-impact + estimate.
maya: Backlog tagging example:
```
labels: [postlaunch:bug, severity:P1, owner:jo]
estimate: 2d
customer-impact: high
```
jo: I'll add repro steps and sample inputs to the ticket now.
tiago: If embed fix looks deeper, we might need a model quant compare run — calling that out early.
kevin: Canary traffic looks better after window tweak: p99 down ~18% on canary nodes. Monitoring continuing.
ashley: Good. Next actions: Kevin continues canary + rollback ready; Jo/Tiago debug embedding; Maya updates backlog and PR template; Sam holds enhancement in waiting column. Reconvene 16:30 to confirm scope for the sprint. :thumbsup:
